title: Legal evidence + owner adoption register
decision: Owner decision, 6 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001): no solicitor is commissioned at this stage; GS-O003's mandatory solicitor approval is replaced by an evidence-based review of each document against current UK legislation and official guidance, followed by explicit owner adoption. Nothing in this register claims solicitor review, certification or guaranteed enforceability.
rules: GS-LEGAL-FINAL-001 supersedes the temporary-domain publication option and prior active drafts. Historical rules and exact earlier adoptions are preserved in previousAdoptionRegister.
Only an explicit owner approval adopts the exact reviewed text. Record ownerAdoptedOn, ownerAdoptedVersion, ownerAdoptedSha256 and adoptionAuthority after approval. Phase 1 records no adoption.
All seven texts have a publication-triggered effective date. Adoption/review does not make them effective and does not authorise publication or cutover.
All seven documents are published together only with the separately authorised WordPress-to-Next.js cutover at gridsmith.uk. Never publish these texts on the temporary domain.

PUBLISHABLE requires the existing documentary publication prerequisites. Production queries and CMS migration remain gated. No permission, insurance, ICO payment or external certification is inferred.

Analytics remains disabled pending current notices, consent, account-specific DPA/transfer/retention settings and verified erasure/operational controls. Privacy prerequisitesMet ANALYTICS-READY records separate activation evidence, never document approval.
